fact: The Countdown country team, at its workshop of 22-26 April 2024, states that DHIS2 reporting rates have been above 90% since 2020 and that 83% of districts had monthly reports at least 90% complete in 2023, but that hospitals report weakly because their migration to DHIS2 is slow and resisted, with hospital reporting forms revised at the end of 2023.
title: Analyse des indicateurs de santé reproductive, maternelle, néonatale, infantile et des adolescents 2019-2023 : Recueil de graphiques avec les principaux résultats et interprétations, Tchad
